sys_script_include.description: Manages persistent multi-turn conversations with tool-use support. Mirrors the notebook pattern: chat() returns a raw response object; add_user_message() and add_assistant_message() handle both plain text and full response objects; text_from_message() extracts text blocks; run_conversation() is the agentic loop that persists every content block (user text, assistant text, tool_use, tool_result) to x_146833_claudec_0_message and maintains the x_146833_claudec_0_session parent record.
sys_script_include.name: ClaudeConversationManager
